note: The guarantees an agentic workflow system can make, each with the attack that tests it, the oracle and Foundry's executable attack test. Competitor harnesses run the same attack offline with a scripted model (experiments/conformance/competitors/). $0: no paid model calls. A row counts as proven for a system only when its attack test runs and passes in this repository; a vendor document is not proof.

properties.name: A model-buildable workflow artifact that the engine can reject when it cannot fail
properties.attack: submit a workflow whose acceptance only checks that outputs exist
properties.oracle: validation or strict lint rejects it

foundry.name: acceptance: presence predicates are not gates

properties.name: Bounded execution enforced by the engine
properties.attack: a fan-out wider than the budget and a run past its step budget
properties.oracle: concurrency never exceeds the bound; a step-budget stop is never hidden by error collection

foundry.name: in-flight nodes never exceed the smaller of the run policy and the workflow budget
map: collect never hides a run-wide stop

properties.name: No duplicated side effect after a crash
properties.attack: kill the worker process mid-effect, then resume

foundry.name: actual worker process loss does not duplicate an idempotent simulator effect

properties.limits: Idempotent effects only on main; non-idempotent exactly-once (runtime2, effect registry) is on an unmerged branch.

properties.name: Resume after a crash from a durable journal, only under identical semantics
properties.attack: a second process resumes a pending run with the same engine and with changed engine source
properties.oracle: identical source resumes; changed source refuses with ENGINE_DRIFT

foundry.name: an actual second process with changed engine source rejects a pending run while identical source resumes

properties.name: Tamper-evident record of what ran
properties.attack: rewrite or truncate journal rows of a finished run
properties.oracle: verify-run with anchors outside the database detects both

foundry.name: anchors outside the database expose a consistent rewrite and a truncation

properties.name: Verification independent of the producer
properties.attack: a model verifier of the same family as the producer
properties.oracle: refused statically, and a different family is picked at run time

foundry.name: different-model independence picks another family and is enforced statically and at runtime

properties.name: Proof that a fan-out covered its inventory
properties.attack: a reader drops, re-reads or invents a unit, or a shard fails
properties.oracle: the run fails its coverage gate

foundry.name: a reader that drops a unit fails the gated run
a failed shard (failure collect) fails the ledger

properties.name: Approval by role, with segregation of duties
properties.attack: answer an approval from the wrong role, or both sides of a segregated pair from one person
properties.oracle: the answer is refused, and the chain records who answered under which matrix

foundry.name: runtime: role, delegation of authority and segregation of duties are enforced on answers

properties.name: Refusal without silent fallback
properties.attack: name an unknown agent or an unverified model
properties.oracle: a typed refusal; no other provider or model is used

foundry.name: CLI does not use an unknown agent or silently fall back

properties.name: Untrusted data cannot drive an effect without a gate (information-flow control)
properties.attack: untrusted input flows into an effectful capability's arguments with no approval or quarantined judgment

foundry.name: probe A.3 case A (control): untrusted data in the effect arguments is rejected

properties.name: The engine's identity covers every module that decides a run
properties.attack: add a semantic module the identity does not hash

foundry.name: every src module the runtime, validator, store and engine import is part of the engine identity
